intro.headline: Ask your documents anything
intro.description: Upload documents or code and ask questions. Answers come from your files, and show which documents and web pages they used.

steps.title: Upload
steps.description: PDFs, Word documents, text, Markdown, HTML and source code are stored in S3 object storage.

steps.title: Index
steps.description: In the background, text is extracted and split into chunks, with code split by function and class. Each chunk is embedded and stored in pgvector.

steps.title: Retrieve
steps.description: Your question is expanded into related queries, matched against the chunks and reranked by a cross-encoder. If web search is on, Brave Search fills the gaps.

steps.title: Answer
steps.description: OpenAI writes the answer from the best chunks, and the demo lists the documents and web pages it used.

sessionExpired: Your previous session expired, so its documents were cleared.

documents.title: Documents
documents.limits: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, HTML or code (.py, .js, .jsx, .ts, .tsx, .java, .go). Up to 10 MB each.
documents.confirmClearAll: Delete every document in this chat?
documents.confirmStartOver: Start over? This deletes the chat, its documents and the conversation.

chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyState: Add a document, wait until it’s ready, then ask about it here.
chat.inputPlaceholder: Ask a question about your documents

hints.processing: Waiting for your documents to finish processing…
hints.noDocuments: Add a document, or turn on web search, to start asking

webSearch.label: Web search fallback
webSearch.hint: Search the web when your documents don't have enough to answer.

topK.label: Chunks to retrieve
topK.hint: How many document chunks are considered for each answer.

threshold.label: Similarity threshold
threshold.hint: How closely a chunk must match the question to be used. Higher is stricter.
